sources.entry: Sharry - Share files easily over the internet between authenticated and anonymous users (both ways) with resumable up- and downloads. GPL-3.0 Scala/Java/deb/Docker

summary.one_liner: Sharry is a self-hosted web application for sharing files, where authenticated users upload files to get shareable download URLs and others can upload to users via alias pages.
summary.what_it_does: Authenticated users can upload files through the web interface with an optional password and a time period after which the file is no longer available. Each upload produces a public URL that can be shared, for example by email, and the download page is hard to guess but open to anyone. Registered users can create alias pages, which are hard-to-guess upload URLs that let anyone send files to that user, with an optional description and an email notification to the user. Alias pages can be disabled or deleted at any time. Uploads use the tus protocol, so interrupted transfers of large files can resume from the last received chunk. The backend is written in Scala and the frontend in Elm.
use_cases: share large files with others by link
receive files from anonymous senders via upload page
send files with expiring download links
resumable large file uploads over http
how_to_run: Install the provided deb file on a Debian-based system
Download the provided zip file and run the script in bin/
Install via the nix package manager (a NixOS module is also available)
Run using Docker, as described in the documentation
notable: Resumable uploads via the tus protocol, continuing from the last received chunk after a dropped connection
Alias pages: hard-to-guess upload URLs that let anyone send files to a registered user
Optional password and expiry time period on shared files
Multiple install routes: deb package, zip script, nix/NixOS module, Docker
caveats: Full documentation is on a separate documentation site, not in the README
Setup beyond the listed install methods is not described in the README
